query: What concrete success metrics and benchmarks (data-quality improvement, imputation error, causal-estimate precision, partner ROI) should trigger scale-up decisions?

response.query: What concrete success metrics and benchmarks (data-quality improvement, imputation error, causal-estimate precision, partner ROI) should trigger scale-up decisions?
response.answer: Scale-up decisions should trigger when data-quality improvement exceeds 15%, imputation error drops below 5%, causal-estimate precision improves by 20%, and partner ROI surpasses 10%.

results.content: The Rwandan genocide of 1994 was one of the defining events of the twentieth century. It ended the illusion that the evil of genocide had been eradicated
